name: BRECVEMA Model of Musical Emotions
citation: Juslin, P.N. (2013). From everyday emotions to aesthetic emotions: Towards a unified theory of musical emotions. Physics of Life Reviews, 10(3), 235-266.

constructs.description: Rapid (50ms) detection of sudden, loud, dissonant, or fast-approaching sounds. Acoustic startle reflex via IC/SC → PnC pathway.
Motor system oscillatory coupling to periodic auditory input via β-oscillation entrainment.
Classical conditioning: musical passage co-occurs with emotional event → implicit evaluation transfer.
Vocal expression code → mirror system → embodied simulation of expressed emotion.
Music evokes visual-spatial imagery via cross-modal mapping (auditory → visual cortex).
Music reinstates episodic memory context via hippocampal pattern completion.
Surprise from violated musical syntax → PE in auditory cortex → dopaminergic signals. Direct PP reduction.
Meta-cognitive evaluation integrating all information channels. IE-DPT dependent: expertise, genre schema, listener goals.

schema_gaps: Mirror system templates for Contagion not yet developed
Aesthetic chills pathway (frisson) not fully specified
irreducible_residual.narrative: Eight interaction-organized music-emotion mechanisms. The irreducible contribution is the claim that these eight specific mechanisms operate simultaneously and interactively during any single musical passage, producing the unique emotional richness of music. No single mechanism accounts for musical emotion; the BRECVEMA contribution is the ORGANIZATION principle — how eight channels combine. Accepted by Feb 23 Expansion Panel.

key_references: Juslin, P.N. (2013). Physics of Life Reviews, 10(3), 235-266.
Juslin, P.N. & Västfjäll, D. (2008). Behavioral and Brain Sciences, 31(5), 559-575.

function_form.function_form: E(m) = Σᵢ Mᵢ(m) · wᵢ(ψ); M ∈ {brainstem, entrainment, contagion, imagery, memory, expectancy, appraisal}

variables.M\u1d62(m): Activation level of mechanism i for music m
variables.w\u1d62(\u03c8): Individual weight for mechanism i (varies with training, culture)

predictions: Brainstem reflex: sudden loud sounds trigger startle in <200ms
Musical expectancy violations (chord surprises) → frisson (piloerection) in ~5-10% of listeners

provenance.historical_context: BRECVEMA identifies 8 mechanisms by which music evokes emotion: Brainstem reflex, Rhythmic entrainment, Evaluative conditioning, Contagion, Visual imagery, Episodic memory, Musical expectancy, Aesthetic judgment. Bridges music psychology and architectural acoustics.
